title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://github.com/xmrig/xmrig/releases/download/v6.22.2/… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors detected an attacker URL linked to CVE-2021-41773, observed 24 times on 2026-11-04. The URL points to a payload hosted on GitHub for xmrig version 6.22.2, associated with the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer). The attacker infrastructure was identified in the US. This URL was used in attacker payloads for tool download or exploitation. Defenders are advised to block and monitor this URL and search logs for related requests.
